findings.trigger: A structured part target also has an explicit A11y snapshot.id; the host changes target.id while the binding stays live. Before MutationObserver delivery, replay the target snapshot with only states.busy=true changed.
findings.observed: update releases/reacquires scalar attributes before recognizing the undelivered host rewrite and overwrites host-later with the cached proto-id. pendingIdWrites classifies the subsequent write as internal, so observer delivery does not recover the authored value.
findings.expected: Preserve the host-authored new value; withdraw the previous dependent contribution and perform collision checks before adopting or rebinding.
findings.impact: The host-authored current identity is erased while the relation continues pointing to the old identity. Existing authored labels or external references to the new ID break.
findings.fix: Recognize the current physical ID provenance before scalar release/replay in every update path, including an undelivered host rewrite; suppress unchanged explicit identity consistently.
findings.originalSequence: Resolved: the original host-write/independent-writer sequence without an intervening projection now passes.

findings.trigger: A generated-ID structured-part target shares its physical element with another logical projector that declares a different explicit ID. Before MutationObserver delivery, replay the target snapshot with only states.busy=true changed.
findings.observed: update retains its older live-ID branch at lines 766–782 without the new ownership classification. An unrelated target-state replay after the independent writer takeover reselects independent-id as the generated owner reservation and restores its controls token before observer delivery; writer disposal does not recover the old generated identity.
findings.expected: Preserve independent scalar ownership while keeping the original generated reservation unavailable during a different-ID takeover; writer release should recover the original identity as governed by existing PUI-625-GENERATED-ID-SURVIVOR-RELEASE coverage (web-reference.test.ts:675–721).
findings.impact: Independent projector ownership is conflated with host authorship and a logical target silently changes its retained identity, breaking the existing direct-reference compatibility boundary.
findings.fix: Apply the independent scalar ownership / internal-write classification to the synchronous update path as well as document observation, before changing reservations.
findings.originalSequence: Resolved: the original host-write/independent-writer sequence without an intervening projection now passes.
